WITH period_rates AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_name,
    CASE WHEN period = 'p1' THEN 'Jan-Apr 2026' ELSE 'May-Oct 2026' END AS period_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      supplier_name,
      on_time,
      CASE
        WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'p1'
        WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN 'p2'
      END AS period
    FROM v_purchasing
    WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL
      AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'
  ) sub
  WHERE period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY supplier_name, period
), diffs AS (
  SELECT
    p1.supplier_name,
    p1.on_time_rate AS rate_p1,
    p2.on_time_rate AS rate_p2,
    (p1.on_time_rate - p2.on_time_rate) AS rate_drop
  FROM period_rates p1
  JOIN period_rates p2 ON p1.supplier_name = p2.supplier_name
  WHERE p1.period_name = 'Jan-Apr 2026' AND p2.period_name = 'May-Oct 2026'
)
SELECT
  supplier_name,
  round(rate_p1::numeric, 4) AS rate_jan_apr,
  round(rate_p2::numeric, 4) AS rate_may_oct,
  round(rate_drop::numeric, 4) AS rate_drop
FROM diffs
ORDER BY rate_drop DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month,
         sum(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT round(((oct.rev - sep.rev)::numeric / NULLIF(sep.rev,0)) * 100, 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM (SELECT rev FROM monthly_rev WHERE month = DATE '2026-10-01') AS oct,
     (SELECT rev FROM monthly_rev WHERE month = DATE '2026-09-01') AS sep

WITH customer_rev AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(revenue) AS rev
    FROM v_sales
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        rev,
        SUM(rev) OVER () AS total_rev,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rev DESC) AS rn
    FROM customer_rev
)
SELECT
    round(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN rev END) / NULLIF(SUM(total_rev), 0)::numeric, 2) AS top_10_pct

WITH rev_q AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) = 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 THEN 'q2'
      WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) = 3 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 THEN 'q3'
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026
    AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM order_date) IN (2,3)
  GROUP BY customer_id, quarter
),
rev_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN quarter = 'q2' THEN rev END) AS rev_q2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN quarter = 'q3' THEN rev END) AS rev_q3
  FROM rev_q
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_lower_rev
FROM rev_pivot
WHERE rev_q2 IS NOT NULL             
  AND rev_q3 IS NOT NULL             
  AND rev_q3 < rev_q2

WITH rev AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN '2025_nov_dec'
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' THEN '2026_jul_aug'
    END AS period,
    SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
       OR order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
  round((
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025_nov_dec' THEN rev END),0) -
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026_jul_aug' THEN rev END),0)
  )::numeric, 2) AS revenue_diff

WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev_q2
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY product_id
),
q3 AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev_q3
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY product_id
),
growth AS (
  SELECT q3.product_id,
         COALESCE(q3.rev_q3,0) - COALESCE(q2.rev_q2,0) AS rev_growth,
         COALESCE(q3.rev_q3,0) AS rev_q3,
         COALESCE(q2.rev_q2,0) AS rev_q2,
         p.product_name
  FROM q3
  LEFT JOIN q2 ON q3.product_id = q2.product_id
  JOIN v_products p ON p.product_id = q3.product_id
)
SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       round(rev_q2::numeric,2) AS rev_q2,
       round(rev_q3::numeric,2) AS rev_q3,
       round(rev_growth::numeric,2) AS rev_growth
FROM growth
ORDER BY rev_growth DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN days_late > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS pct_late
FROM v_purchasing
WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(s.qty) AS units_sold,
  SUM(s.margin) AS total_margin,
  SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue,
  round((SUM(s.margin)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0)) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM v_sales s
JOIN v_products p ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(s.qty) >= 100
ORDER BY margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 3
